name: synthetic-error-trigger-referral
description: Crediting a referral for someone who is not in the program. Distinct from the 200/success:false repeat, which is not an error at all. Vendor non-2xx is DATA: the engine classifies it as a provider error, forces zero usage, and passes the envelope through — `code` is the stable half a caller branches on. Authored from the GrowSurf REST v2 (2.0.0) response shape, verified field for field against a live deployment on 2026-09-22; the identities are GrowSurf's own published example values.
